text:
jamie_pm: FYI — Gladius legal pushed a hard ask into the contract draft: 99.99% uptime + p99 tail latency <150ms for hosted inference, 24/7 Sev1 support window, and dedicated capacity option. They want commitment in next quarter. Can we triage?

sarah_sales: they're on a large renewal. deal motion needs clear answers on what we can and can't promise. They specifically asked for on-call escalation to an engineering owner.

lee_support: do we have an existing support tier that maps to 24/7? currently enterprise tier has 8x5 with on-call for SEVs during business hours only. We have runbooks but no SLA-backed 24/7 guarantee.

omar_eng: technical notes: 99.99% availability for hosted text generation at scale + p99 <150ms is plausible only with dedicated reservation and careful routing. Requirements: reserved GPU pool, autoscale guardrails, KV cache affinity, and a regional failover plan. Also need perf tests focused on short live-serving latencies (not just throughput).

maria_sre: SRE perspective: that uptime target implies strict SLI definitions, burn-rate alerts, and a runbook that escalates to eng-oncall within X mins. Need SLO ledger and retro process for missed SLOs. Also will require increased monitoring retention for audits.

tony_finance: pricing note: dedicated capacity + 24/7 support should carry a material uplift. Need to model cost: baseline reserved cost + on-call cost + SLA credit policy.

jamie_pm: action proposal: classify as "contractual-slo-request" epic, create technical spike for feasibility (2w), and a pricing proposal. Owners: @omar_eng spike, @maria_sre observability/runbook, @tony_finance pricing, @lee_support support playbook. Can someone create the ticket?

triage-bot: Created ticket PRJ-4321 with labels: enterprise, sla-request, high-priority. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRJ-4321

sarah_sales: timeline: customer needs formal response by EOD next Fri. We should target a 3-business-day internal proposal to legal/sales before that.

omar_eng: early feasibility notes and rough checklist:
```
- baseline capacity estimate for dedicated pool
- perf test plan (p99 <150ms target) with representative prompts
- fallback policy: degrade to lower-QPS model variant when starving capacity
- canary release policy + automated rollback conditions
```

maria_sre: suggested SLI snippet for PRJ-4321: 
```
service: inference-hosted
sli:
  availability: "success_rate_over_5m"
  latency_p99: "latency_ms_p99_over_5m"
slo:
  availability: "99.99"
  latency_p99: "<150"
```

lee_support: runbook/RTO items to add: on-call pager -> eng lead -> SRE escalation -> legal contact. Add template for SLA credit calculation.

jamie_pm: acceptance/launch criteria (draft): 1) automated e2e load & p99 tests passing in staging for 2w, 2) SLI/SLO definitions instrumented and dashboards in Console, 3) runbook and pager flows tested in a DR drill, 4) pricing & SLA credit terms approved by finance/legal, 5) canary rollout and rollback verified.

tony_finance: confirm will need SLA credit cap and clear failure windows before we sign. I'll draft the cap options.

omar_eng: estimate: spike + basic infra + perf harness = ~2.5 engineer-weeks. Full implementation for dedicated pool + telemetry + runbook = ~8-10 engineer-weeks plus SRE onboarding.

sarah_sales: can we deliver a pragmatic contract response without full implementation? e.g., propose a conditional commitment: committed uptime after dedicated pool is provisioned + acceptance testing; until then offer milestone-based credit. Would that be acceptable legally?

maria_sre: that staged commitment is reasonable. We should include measurable acceptance test steps and a holdback period. Also include a clause for force majeure / region outages.

jamie_pm: decision: proceed with staged approach. I'll create the epic and break into PRJ-4321 (spike) and PRJ-4322 (implementation). Owners set as discussed. Target: internal proposal in 3 business days, spike kickoff tomorrow.

lee_support: I'll prepare the initial support playbook draft and sample pager escalation.

omar_eng: starting spike tomorrow — will post early perf numbers in this thread.

sarah_sales: thanks everyone — :thumbsup: I'll sync with legal on the staged contract language and loop back.

triage-bot: PRJ-4321 moved to in-progress. 

jamie_pm: tagging for visibility: @maria_sre @omar_eng @lee_support @tony_finance. We'll review draft proposal on Wed 11am PT.
